niche: Psychology & human behavior (biases, habits, social dynamics)

ideas.title: The Favor Trick to Make Friends
ideas.angle: Explain why asking someone for a small favor actually makes them like you more, reversing the common logic that we should do things for others to be liked.

hook.en: Stop doing favors to be liked.
hook.fr: Arrête de rendre service pour plaire.

ideas.reason: Social engineering and 'dark' psychology hacks are currently peaking on TikTok and Shorts. This specific counter-intuitive advice generates high comments from skeptics.
sources: Jecker & Landy (1969) study on the Benjamin Franklin Effect

ideas.title: Why You See the Same Thing Everywhere
ideas.angle: Explore the Frequency Illusion: why after you learn a new word or see a new car, it suddenly appears everywhere in your daily life.

hook.en: You're seeing this everywhere for a reason.
hook.fr: Tu vois ça partout pour une raison.

ideas.reason: This 'glitch in the matrix' style content has high retention because it explains a common eerie experience viewers have all felt but couldn't name.
sources: Selective Attention and Confirmation Bias research

ideas.title: Why Being Clumsy is Your Superpower
ideas.angle: Explain the Pratfall Effect: how making a small mistake or being slightly clumsy makes highly competent people more attractive and relatable to others.

hook.en: Your mistakes make you more likable.
hook.fr: Tes erreurs te rendent plus attirant.

ideas.reason: Vulnerability is a trending topic in self-improvement. It provides relief to viewers who feel the pressure of perfectionism, making it highly shareable.
sources: Elliot Aronson (1966) 'The influence of a spill on the evaluation of a person'
